WITH income_with_department AS (
  SELECT maj.department
  FROM income i
  JOIN member m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id
  JOIN major maj ON m.link_to_major = maj.major_id
),
department_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    department,
    COUNT(*) as income_count
  FROM income_with_department
  GROUP BY department
),
total_income_count AS (
  SELECT SUM(income_count) as total FROM department_counts
),
department_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    dc.department,
    dc.income_count,
    CAST(dc.income_count AS FLOAT) / tic.total as share
  FROM department_counts dc
  CROSS JOIN total_income_count tic
),
overall_average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM department_shares
)
SELECT 
  SUM(ds.income_count) as sum_of_counts,
  AVG(ds.share) as average_of_shares,
  AVG(ds.share - oas.avg_share) as average_of_differences
FROM department_shares ds
CROSS JOIN overall_average_share oas
WHERE ds.share > oas.avg_share
